waves.intent: Serves criteria 2 and 3 (parse half). waves.title: W3 — One registrar: deliverables_register.py resolves the effort dir, the Where form and the active step, and appends idempotently under WRITE_LOCK
waves.intent: Serves criterion 1 and premortem 1 (fan-out drift) without touching any finish point yet — exactly one module knows how to resolve the effort dir, the active step, the Where form, idempotency, locking and the atomic write. New stdlib-only deliverables_register.py with ONE entry point register(effort_dir, what, where, *, date=None, step=None, project_folder=None) -> {'written': bool, 'reason': str}: normalizes whitespace, scans existing rows for an exact (what, where) match → no-op with reason 'dup'; else appends under paths.WRITE_LOCK via a UNIQUE-named temp file (.DELIVERABLES.<pid>.<ns>.tmp + os.replace — the e81b193 WinError-5 lesson), minting the W1 header when the file is absent; never raises (best-effort, returns the reason). Helpers: effort_dir_for(run_folder, project_folder) — the run's folder, or the nearest parent up to the project root, that carries ECGBERHT.md, else the project root (the North-Star risk-row rule); where_for(effort_dir, project_folder, pid, *, abs_path=None, lane=None, job_id=None) — an artifact inside the effort dir is the plain in-effort rel path in backticks (already openable by realpath containment), an artifact outside the effort but inside the project folder is /artifact/<pid>?path=<rel-from-project-root>, a lane job with no file is /report/<pid>/<lane>/<job_id>, always forward slashes (aeef2d9 lesson); active_step(effort_dir, hint=None) — the hint wins, else the step whose status is 'active' in steward_campaign.read_map(effort_dir) rendered as its 1-based index (what stepDeliverables at shared.js:275 matches by number), empty when there is no map so the row still lands and the tile still shows it. Per the elegance CUT of P4.5, no latest_for_step accessor is built.

waves.title: W4 — A finished run registers itself: three one-line hooks (Gandalf finalize, lane-job STATUS_DONE, commissioned RUN_DONE); failed or cancelled never register; every outcome journaled
waves.intent: Serves criterion 1. Each finish point contributes only its (what, where, step) facts in a one-line call into W3's register. Hook A — gandalf.run_gandalf immediately after the successful _append_index(store, pid, record) (gandalf.py:1737) and ONLY when ok is True: register(effort_dir_for(store, folder), 'Gandalf read <tier> — <verdict>', where_for(..., abs_path=store/report_rel), date=ts[:10]); the crash-reconcile finally block (gandalf.py:1764) and the cancelled path never register; a cockpit-commissioned run's store IS the effort dir (_gandalf_runs at steward_routes.py:585 reads <cdir>/gandalf/run-*), so its Where is the plain gandalf/run-<id>/report.md. Hook B — job_runner._finalize next to the existing finalize_effort bridge (job_runner.py:2589; OUTSIDE WRITE_LOCK, lazy import, broad guard, same precedent) when final_status == STATUS_DONE and the record has project_id + folder_path + lane in ('research', 'plan'): register(rec.get('effort_dir') or project root, '<researchPrime|Crucible> <lane> report — <label>', '/report/<pid>/<lane>/<job_id>'); launch_guarded/launch_lane gain an optional effort_dir passthrough onto the job record with no behavior change when absent. Hook C — commission_session.finish_run (repo-root commission_session.py) when the outcome is RUN_DONE: per HOLD P2.7 register ONLY the human-facing report/plan/execlog roles from summarizer.session_doc_roles — never agent/provenance/raw session files — with what = '<skill> — <role>: <filename>', step hint = the commission record's step, effort dir = the commission's campaign dir. The Foreman EXECUTION-LOG registers here once at finish (brownfield's build-doc rule), which delivers the North Star's 'Foreman execution log' link. HOLD P2.8 (live per-wave GO rows via a foreman_go_waves parser on the watcher's on_tick): NOT built by default — folded into Hook C; build it only if John answers yes to the one-line question at the Stage-2 gate. Journal: each hook emits the EXISTING journal event kind with payload {register: written|dup|<reason>} so a silent no-op is auditable (the stream-json silent-empty lesson). A registrar exception can never fail a finished run.
